metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over South Los Angeles, California lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (primary: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2; fallback: COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2), filter October 1–23 for years 2018, 2019, 2021 over a South Los Angeles bounding box. 2. Masking strategy: Mask with qa_value >= 0.75 (standard quality filter). No cloud mask needed. 3. Valid Zero vs. Null: Check image collection size (C1), valid pixel counts post-mask (C2), and ensure mean is finite and within plausible range; if NaN/Null -> C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[-118.5, 34.05], [-118.5, 33.6], [-118.1, 33.6], [-118.1, 34.05]], null, false ); const startDay = {month: 10, day: 1}; const endDay = {month: 10, day: 24}; // exclusive to include up to 23rd // Helper: Build collection with fallback function buildCollection(start, end) { const offl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom); return offl.size().gt(0).conditional( offl, ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom) ); } function maskNO2(img) { const qa = img.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return img.updateMask(mask).select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); } function getPeriod(year) { const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, startDay.month, startDay.day); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, endDay.month, endDay.day); return {start, end}; } async function yearStats(year) { const {start, end} = getPeriod(year); // Try OFFL first, fallback to NRTI if OFFL empty const offl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom); const offlSize = offl.size().getInfo(); let used = 'OFFL'; let col = offl; if (offlSize === 0) { const nrti = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom); const nrtiSize = nrti.size().getInfo(); if (nrtiSize === 0) { return {year, size: 0, used: 'None'}; } col = nrti; used = 'NRTI'; } const size = col.size().getInfo(); const colMasked = col.map(maskNO2); const meanImg = colMasked.mean(); const reduceArgs = {geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9}; const meanDict = meanImg.reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), ...reduceArgs}).getInfo(); const countDict = meanImg.reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), ...reduceArgs}).getInfo(); const totalDict = ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), ...reduceArgs}).getInfo(); const meanVal = meanDict ? meanDict.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density : null; const validCount = countDict ? countDict.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density : 0; const totalCount = totalDict ? totalDict.constant : 0; return { year, size, used, mean: meanVal, validCount: validCount || 0, totalCount: totalCount || 0 }; } // Compute stats for 2018, 2019, 2021 const y2018 = await yearStats(2018); const y2019 = await yearStats(2019); const y2021 = await yearStats(2021); // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks // C1: Empty collection for any year if (y2018.size === 0 || y2019.size === 0 || y2021.size === 0) { console.log(`2018 Images: ${y2018.size || 0} (Used: ${y2018.used || 'None'})`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${y2019.size || 0} (Used: ${y2019.used || 'None'})`); console.log(`2021 Images: ${y2021.size || 0} (Used: ${y2021.used || 'None'})`); console.log('Empty collection for at least one period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } function fmtYearLine(y) { const vpct = y.totalCount > 0 ? (100 * y.validCount / y.totalCount) : 0; const meanStr = (typeof y.mean === 'number') ? y.mean.toExponential(3) : 'null'; return `Y${y.year}: Images=${y.size} (${y.used}), ValidPx=${y.validCount}/${y.totalCount} (${vpct.toFixed(1)}%), Mean=${meanStr} mol/m^2`; } console.log('Region: South Los Angeles bbox [-118.5,33.6]-[-118.1,34.05], Oct 1–23'); console.log(fmtYearLine(y2018)); console.log(fmtYearLine(y2019)); console.log(fmtYearLine(y2021)); // 3. Processing checks: C2 and C3 // C2: No valid pixels after masking for any year if (y2018.validCount === 0 || y2019.validCount === 0 || y2021.validCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after QA masking for at least one period.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // C3: Calculation failure if mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range function invalidMean(v) { if (v === null || v === undefined) return true; if (!isFinite(v)) return true; // Plausibility check for tropospheric NO2 (mol/m^2) return Math.abs(v) > 5e-3; } if (invalidMean(y2018.mean) || invalidMean(y2019.mean) || invalidMean(y2021.mean)) { console.log('Mean value invalid (null/NaN/out-of-range) for at least one period.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Final Comparison: Is 2021 lower than BOTH 2019 and 2018? const isLower = (y2021.mean < y2019.mean) && (y2021.mean < y2018.mean); console.log(`Comparison: 2021 (${y2021.mean.toExponential(3)}) vs 2019 (${y2019.mean.toExponential(3)}), 2018 (${y2018.mean.toExponential(3)})`); // 5. Final Answer console.log(isLower ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
